2402160559.query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM contributions
        WHERE 1=1
        AND ST_Intersects(geom, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((8.407288 49.346599, 8.839874 49.346599, 8.839874 49.532339, 8.407288 49.532339, 8.407288 49.346599))', 4326))
        AND valid_to > '2026-01-01'::timestamptz
        AND (status_geom_type).geom_type = 'LineString' AND (tags ? $1 OR tags @> $2) AND NOT (tags @> $3 OR tags @> $4 OR (tags @> $5 AND tags @> $6) OR tags @> $7 OR tags @> $8);
